title: IP Configuration
description: Single declarative source of truth for one IP/subsystem. Every agent, skill, template, and VIP parameterizes off this file so the flow is generic across any IP.

version.description: Semantic version of the IP spec, e.g. 0.1.0.

clock.description: Name of the clock this reset is associated with.

bus.description: The register-access bus interface the IP exposes.

protocol.description: Bus protocol name. OPEN-ENDED: validated against flow/config/vip_registry.yaml (buses:), not a fixed enum, so any protocol can be added via the registry + a VIP plug-in.

vip.description: Optional explicit VIP path/name override for a custom or plug-in bus VIP. Defaults to the registry entry for `protocol`.

registers.description: Pointer to the SystemRDL register description (the single source of truth for RTL, RAL, and docs via PeakRDL).

source.description: Path (relative to the IP dir) to the register description file.

format.description: Only SystemRDL is the source of truth; other formats are converted to it upstream.

top_component.description: Name of the top addrmap in the RDL, if not auto-detected.

regblock.description: PeakRDL regblock options, read by flow/scripts/gen_regs.py so the generated RTL is reproducible from this config alone. All optional.

default_reset.description: Default: derived from the bus reset in resets: (sync/async, active high/low).

interfaces.description: Non-bus side interfaces (protocol pins, streaming, GPIO pads, etc.). Each maps to a UVM agent from the VIP library.

kind.description: Interface kind, e.g. gpio, spi, i2c, uart, axi-stream, custom. OPEN-ENDED: validated against flow/config/vip_registry.yaml (interfaces:).

vip.description: Optional explicit VIP path/name override for a custom or plug-in interface VIP.

has_vip.description: True if a ready VIP exists in vip/ for this kind (informational; the registry is authoritative).

verification.description: Verification intent that drives vPlan generation and coverage-closure targets.

tracks.description: Which environment(s) to generate. Single-track: standard SystemVerilog UVM only (the pyuvm/cocotb track has been retired). Kept as an array for forward compatibility.

primary_simulator.description: UVM simulator: AMD Vivado xsim, the only simulator this flow uses. It runs complete standard UVM with native constrained randomization, functional + code coverage, and SVA.

uvm_version.description: UVM library version. xsim ships a precompiled UVM 1.2; 2017/2020 require compiling the bundled Accellera uvm-core sources.

regression.description: Seed policy read by flow/scripts/run_regression.py's read_seed_policy().

seeds.description: Seed count for directed / seed-invariant tests (auto-detected from source; 1 is complete, more is byte-identical waste).

random_seeds.description: Fallback seed count for a randomized test not given an explicit count in seeds_per_test.

seeds_per_test.description: Per-test explicit seed count, keyed by test class name — size to that test's actual random-variable space.

key_scenarios.description: High-level scenarios the DV lead wants covered; seed the vPlan.

traceability.description: ID prefixes for the requirement->coverage traceability spine.

provenance.description: Populated by the spec-ingestor when this config was auto-extracted from a requirement document. Records the source and everything the user must confirm at the ingestion gate.

source_document.description: Path to the requirement spec this config was extracted from.

needs_confirmation.description: Human-readable fields/assumptions the user must confirm or correct before the flow proceeds past the ingestion gate.

subsystem.description: OPTIONAL. Present only for multi-block subsystems; single-IP configs omit it entirely. Provides the hierarchy hooks so integration-level verification can be added later without reworking single-IP configs.

config.description: Path to the child block's ip_config.yaml.

base_address.description: Base address of this block in the subsystem address map (hex string, e.g. 0x4000_0000).

protocol.description: Fabric/bus protocol connecting the blocks (validated against vip_registry.yaml).
